onboarding.welcome: Welcome! Send me a YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X/Twitter, Spotify, or Pinterest link in any group. I can download videos, music, and images.

download.timeout: ❌ Download is taking too long. Please try again later.
download.too_large: ❌ The video is {size} MB. I can't send videos larger than {limit} MB.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
